cross_analysis.behavior: scheduled/workflow_run analysis commits and pushes generated artifacts to main

root_causes: The scheduler trusts any existing workflow filename, allowing queued entries to dispatch workflows beyond read-only validation.
The merge queue exposes an all-open-PR mode with unlimited processing and actual merging enabled by default.
Cross Analysis has repository write permission and commits/pushes generated outputs to main.
The public brain-corpus export is independently addressed by inherited PR #1546 changes.
proposed_controls: Disable the autonomous merge queue with read-only permissions and no branch updates, approvals, comments or merges.
Constrain scheduler dispatch to ci.yml and barrot-bundle-operational-smoke.yml only; reject workflow inputs and timezone-naive timestamps.
Serialize scheduler ticks and add a bounded timeout; preserve the existing queue mechanism with its limited contents/actions write permissions.
Make Cross Analysis read-only, prevent credential persistence, and upload bounded artifacts rather than committing/pushing to main.
Register regression tests for all controls in core CI.
Retain PR #1546's tested brain-corpus export disablement and current-tree dump removal.
residual_risks: Scheduler retains contents/actions write permissions for queue persistence and allowlisted workflow dispatch; it is constrained, not fully read-only.
Historical Git objects, forks, caches and external copies of brain-corpus dumps are not erased by current-tree removal.
Other external-action workflows are covered by separate open proposals #1539 and #1543 and remain active on main until authorized containment.
Branch-protection administrative details and required-check enforcement remain incompletely verified.
